evidence: The ALD HfO2 films were grown on p-type Si(001) substrates to investigate the growth behaviors and film characteristics. The Si substrates were cleaned with acetone, ethanol, and deionized water. The growth characteristics were systematically investigated with respect to the precursor exposure time, reactant exposure time, number of cycles, and growth temperature. The film thickness was measured using a spectroscopic ellipsometer (Elli-SE-F, Ellipso Technology).
